nodes.label: PlayerController (CharacterBody2D)
nodes.rationale: Central player script. Never reads raw input; consumes PlayerInput signals + get_aim_vector(). Combat is driven entirely by the equipped WeaponData and its behavior plugin; per-instance state lives on equipped_instance while stats are read from equipped_weapon.

nodes.label: PlayerAnimator (code-driven puppet)
nodes.rationale: Builds core locomotion anims programmatically; weapon-specific anims come from WeaponAnimator plugins loaded from weapon_data.animator_script. Animation tuning exposed as @export so it can be dialed from the Inspector, baked at _ready().

nodes.label: PlayerInput (unified input layer)
nodes.rationale: Merges virtual joystick/touch and keyboard+mouse into ONE canonical signal stream. TOUCH vs KBM mode auto-switch; charge is holdable indefinitely (charge_hold_time keeps counting past full for mage laser overdrive).

nodes.label: WeaponData (weapon Resource)
nodes.rationale: Base Resource holding per-weapon stats, animation names, and per-weapon grip/hold/visual @export tuning groups (Sword/Staff/Bow/Prayer). animator_script names the WeaponAnimator subclass; behavior_script/charged_style select the charged-attack behavior plugin.

nodes.label: Virtual Joystick
nodes.rationale: Fixed-position left-half touch joystick; math done in base panel local space so compound parent scaling is handled automatically.

nodes.label: Fx (VFX/damage-number autoload)
nodes.rationale: Scene-safe transient effect manager; effects parented to the autoload (not the current scene) so a scene change never orphans them. Every tween callback guarded with is_instance_valid().

nodes.label: WeaponAnimator (base plugin)
nodes.rationale: Stateless RefCounted base for per-weapon animation providers. Receives everything via args so animators can be freely swapped at runtime. Provides the shared angle-parameterized make_directional_swing builder and track helpers.

nodes.label: FistsAnimator
nodes.rationale: Default weapon; no sprite. Provides attack_right, attack_left, uppercut.

nodes.label: SwordAnimator
nodes.rationale: One-handed short sword: hilt locked in the FORWARD hand (LeftArmPivot), sword arm damped while moving so the blade doesn't flail, back hand swings free. Charged is a TWO-HANDED lunging thrust (back hand comes onto the grip). All placement read from weapon_data 'Sword Hold & Visual' @export group with const fallbacks.

nodes.label: StaffAnimator
nodes.rationale: Two-handed staff: both hands grip adjacent on the shaft and are both damped while moving so the staff stays composed. Attacks: wide sweep + quick jab.

nodes.label: MageStaffAnimator
nodes.rationale: Extends StaffAnimator; inherits sweep/jab and adds staff_charged cast + staff_aim battle-stance loop. The laser beam itself is hitscan code in playercontroller; these anims are only body language.

nodes.label: WandAnimator
nodes.rationale: Healer one-handed wand: flick pokes + wand_heal channel pose (HP/mana logic lives in playercontroller). Wand texture code-generated when no icon.

nodes.label: ProjectileWeaponAnimator (bow)
nodes.rationale: Two-handed bow: front hand holds the riser, back hand draws/looses. Fires a real projectile via a _fire_projectile method track. Bow texture code-generated when no icon.

nodes.label: PrayerAnimator
nodes.rationale: Healer empty-handed prayer: no sprite; hands rub together and a _trigger_prayer_effect method track fires at the climax so the 1-in-7 lightning roll syncs with the animation.

nodes.label: PlayerAnimator.equip_weapon_visual
nodes.rationale: CRASH GUARD: anim_player.stop() before mutating the animation library — replacing a track while it is being evaluated leaves stale track caches and segfaults (Godot 4.3).

nodes.label: PlayerAnimator.play_attack
nodes.rationale: Combo-aware, 8-way aim-quantized. Horizontal aim uses the weapon's authored combo_anims; other octants build (and cache) an angle-parameterized swing via WeaponAnimator.make_directional_swing.

nodes.label: PlayerAnimator.play_uppercut
nodes.rationale: Plays the equipped weapon's charged_anim (falls back to 'uppercut'). Reused by charged melee, laser cast, and heal channel.

nodes.label: WeaponAnimator.get_hold_positions
nodes.rationale: Returns arm-position overrides (and per-arm swing damping) that replace base_larm/base_rarm in locomotion anims so the character holds the weapon during idle/walk/run.

nodes.label: WeaponAnimator.make_directional_swing (static)
nodes.rationale: ONE angle-parameterized builder produces all 8 attack directions, reused by both the player puppet and monsters via opts. Installs _enable_hitbox / _spawn_directional_slash / _disable_hitbox method tracks.

nodes.label: WeaponBehavior (base = melee)
nodes.rationale: Player forwards charge events to a behavior plugin instead of switching on a hardcoded style enum, so adding a new attack KIND is a new subclass, never an edit to playercontroller. Behaviors compose PUBLIC player verbs rather than reaching into player internals.

nodes.label: LaserBehavior
nodes.rationale: Charged hitscan beam for the mage Arcane Conduit; any meaningful hold fires a charge-scaled beam, a bare tap falls back to a normal poke. Holding locks the aim battle stance + mana-circle telegraph.

nodes.label: HealBehavior
nodes.rationale: Charged support channel (healer wand): a full charge spends mana to restore HP; anything less is a normal attack.

nodes.label: PrayerBehavior
nodes.rationale: Healer's empty-handed prayer: every release (tap OR hold) prays; each prayer has a 1-in-7 chance to be answered with a lightning bolt on the closest nearby enemy, rolled at the animation climax via a method track.

nodes.label: EnemyBase
nodes.rationale: Shared enemy foundation: subclasses implement _enemy_physics/_enemy_ready hooks while the base handles death/stagger/downed states, damage, hit flash, an attack hitbox that damages the player honoring parry/i-frames, and LOS aggro.

nodes.label: EnemyBase.trip
nodes.rationale: HARD RULE: only bipedal (trippable) enemies can be tripped; everything else no-ops. Returns true only when the knockdown actually landed so the slider pays for it.

nodes.label: EnemyBase._on_attack_hitbox_hit
nodes.rationale: The enemy hitbox routes through player.take_damage so the PLAYER resolves parry/i-frames internally.

nodes.label: Boss FOURBLADE
nodes.rationale: 4-armed, 4-sword miniboss ~4x player size. Each summoned sword independently accrues randomized damage power over time (telegraphed by glow); a striking sword spends its power and resets. Summon/dismiss any subset, telegraphed dashes, and a cooldown grab-and-throw avoidable by dodge/parry.

nodes.label: BossFourblade._attempt_grab
nodes.rationale: Grab reach-check: dodge i-frames or an active parry beat it; a perfect parry staggers the boss open.

nodes.label: Mirror Warrior
nodes.rationale: A glowing-blue reflection of the player fought with the player's own warrior kit: directional sword combos, a parry that staggers the player, evasive rolls, and a slide that trips the player. Bipedal (trippable) and bleeds (flesh). Reuses the player puppet (mirror_skin.tscn) tinted blue.

nodes.label: MirrorWarrior.take_damage (parry/i-frame override)
nodes.rationale: Overrides take_damage to resolve its own i-frames and a perfect parry that negates, staggers the player, and ripostes.

nodes.label: MirrorWarrior._process_slide (slide-trip)
nodes.rationale: One attempt per slide: always passes through (evade), but only a 30% roll trips the player, and a successful knockdown costs 50 stamina.

nodes.label: Bombug
nodes.rationale: Small winged centipede that flies at the player, rolls into a ball, and explodes after a 1s fuse. Kill it before the boom to defuse (full EXP); the blast routes through player.take_damage so dodge/parry beat it. Not trippable (flying).

nodes.label: Mannequin (training dummy)
nodes.rationale: Stationary training dummy: effectively unkillable (regenerates), reacts to hits, shows a floating DPS/last-hit readout, and with attacks enabled performs slow telegraphed swings so you can practice parry/dodge timing. Not trippable (mounted on a post).

nodes.label: Slime Monster
nodes.rationale: Hopper with PATROL/AGGRO/WINDUP/LUNGE/RECOVER telegraphed bite; HP/EXP/damage scale with random size. Not trippable (a blob with no legs).

nodes.label: ARCHITECTURE.md (Wonders Of Creation)
nodes.rationale: Current post-overhaul context report; supersedes CODEBASE_CONTEXT.md.

nodes.label: CODEBASE_CONTEXT.md (superseded)
nodes.rationale: Describes the pre-overhaul codebase; historical reference only, superseded by ARCHITECTURE.md.

nodes.label: Weapon behavior-as-plugin architecture
nodes.rationale: Move attack EXECUTION off the player god-class onto a WeaponBehavior plugin. WeaponData.get_behavior() picks one (explicit behavior_script wins, else derived from charged_style fallback). Removing the 3 charged_style if/else branches from playercontroller means a new attack kind is a new subclass, zero player edits (fixes risk R1).

nodes.label: Charged-attack flow (charged_style to behavior)
nodes.rationale: On attack release the player forwards charge level+hold to the equipped weapon's behavior.on_release; wants_charge_stance() gates the aim/telegraph lock. charged_style is kept only as a fallback selector for get_behavior().

nodes.label: Directional dodge / tripping / mirror combat mechanic
nodes.rationale: Directional dodge (leap/slide/roll from movement input); sliding under a BIPED trips it (DOWNED 2s, bonus damage). Tripping is a symmetric shared verb: player trips monsters and monsters trip the player. The Mirror Warrior shows the whole kit off from the other side.
nodes.norm_label: directional dodge / tripping / mirror combat mechanic

nodes.label: Bipedal-only trip rule
nodes.rationale: HARD RULE: you can only sweep the legs from something with two legs. EnemyBase.trippable defaults false; set true only on humanoids (player + Mirror Warrior). Slime/bombug/mannequin/whisperer/boss are immune by nature. Declarative and impossible to forget per-monster.

nodes.label: Slide-trip chance-roll + stamina cost
nodes.rationale: A slide always passes through with i-frames (evade), but the knockdown only lands on a roll: player SLIDE_TRIP_CHANCE=0.6, Mirror=0.3, per opponent-per-slide. A successful knockdown costs +50 stamina; trip() returns bool so the slider only pays on a real knockdown.

nodes.label: hit_fx blood routing
nodes.rationale: EnemyBase.hit_fx routes take_damage to the matching Fx reaction (flesh bleeds via Fx.blood_spray, goo default). Keeps entity-specific reactions declarative; only the Mirror is flesh for now.

nodes.label: EnemyBase enemy framework contract
nodes.rationale: Extend it, don't reimplement: override _enemy_ready/_enemy_physics/_on_staggered; base provides take_damage, _die (scaled EXP), apply_stagger (parry hook), attack-hitbox helper routing through player.take_damage, and LOS aggro.

nodes.label: FOURBLADE dynamic sword-power signature
nodes.rationale: 'Attack points at will' interpreted as visible, telegraphed per-sword randomized damage: each sword accrues a random power over time (glow = telegraph), spends it on a strike, then resets. Unpredictable but fair.

nodes.label: Dungeon Stage 1 escape-themed modular level
nodes.rationale: A flat side-scrolling dungeon the player escapes, assembled from reusable module scenes via a layout array (static now, procedural-ready). Reuses the combat plumbing for breakables and the existing interact action for interactables; the FOURBLADE boss guards the exit.

nodes.label: Breakables reuse the combat damage path
nodes.rationale: Breakable rides the EnemyHurtbox layer (value 4) so the player's AttackHitbox and laser already detect it, and defines take_damage like enemies. Kept in group 'breakable' NOT 'enemy' so slime aggro, bombug targeting, and prayer-lightning never target pots.
nodes.norm_label: breakables reuse the combat damage path
